title: A MAP OF EACH SECTOR ON THE SECTOR PAGE
why: From the visual pass of 2026-10-02: WHERE ARE YOU GOING? was two rows of text over an empty page. Each row now carries a drawn map of its sector from the fixed layout: the ground, the named zones, the buildings and landmarks, and the extraction points as rings. No build and no seeded draw; the map is drawn into a small canvas when the page renders.
now: The sector page now shows a map of each sector beside its name: zones, buildings and the extraction points.
